whenToUse: An HR home: headcount trend, department split, eNPS and comment themes.
Approving leave from a who's-out calendar and tracking open roles on a hiring board.
avoidWhen: Planning shifts or rooms over time — use resource-calendar.
a11y: The who's-out calendar is an ARIA table with row and column headers.
Declining leave requires a reason field linked with aria-describedby; keep that label visible.
